name: QR Code Generator
description: Generate QR codes for URLs, text, and contact info with library management
author: Anthony Sieben

setup: None needed - it's a self-contained tool. Optionally set a default output folder in Settings.
how_it_works: Open the app. On the generator tab, enter a URL, text, or contact info and the QR code is created.
The library tab keeps the codes you've generated so you can find and reuse them.
output: A saved QR-code image you can drop into paperwork, plus a library of the codes you've made.

fields.label: Default Output Folder
fields.description: Default folder for saving generated QR codes
